name: Bharat Wire Ropes Limited

annual_report.business: Bharat Wire Ropes Limited is a leading steel wire rope manufacturing company established in 1986, producing wire ropes, slings, and spiral strands for diverse applications including construction, mining, oil & gas, ports, elevators, and defence.
key_risks: Geopolitical instability and war in Middle East disrupting logistics (Strait of Hormuz)
Volatile commodity prices and sticky inflation
Elevated crude oil prices pressuring import bill and inflation
High borrowing costs due to RBI's cautious stance
Revenue recognition risks related to discounts, rebates, and incentives
Recoverability of PSI receivables from government authorities (INR 12,857.58 Lakhs as at March 31, 2026)

latest_guidance.statement: Industrial Promotion Subsidy equivalent to 100% of eligible investments as per SGST for maximum INR 4,350 Mn, disbursements already begun
Global steel wire rope market projected to reach USD 12.63 bn by 2034 from USD 9.04 bn in 2024 at 3.4% CAGR
India infrastructure capex earmarked INR 11.21 lakh crore for FY26
Parvatmala Pariyojana targets 250+ projects, 1,200+ km ropeway length in 5 years with INR 1.25 lakh crore outlay
US sales share rose to 13% from 8% driven by improving acceptance of product quality; further growth expected
